_comment: wp_vncorp — keyless Vietnamese business-registry lookup (tax code / MST, or a company name) against public mirrors. Every endpoint URL template, the fetch profile, and the Vietnamese-label -> canonical-field map live here (RULE 3) so a mirror going stale or a new label variant is a data edit, not a code change. `{query}` is URL-encoded by the caller before substitution. Nothing here is case data — these are public mirror hostnames and generic Vietnamese business-registry vocabulary.

settings._comment: ua is an Android Chrome string (project decision: prefer an Android UA for web requests over a desktop one); timeout_seconds is the socket timeout per mirror fetch.
settings.ua: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14; Pixel 8) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36

sources._comment: Public VN business-registry mirrors, queried in order. `mst_url` is used for a 10/13-digit tax-code (MST) query; `name_url` (falling back to `mst_url` if absent) is used for a company-name query. Each is a keyless HTML page — no account, no key.

label_map._comment: Vietnamese (accented and ASCII-folded) label variants -> canonical field name. wp_vncorp folds diacritics before comparing, so an accented label in real HTML still matches the ASCII variant listed here. Order is the field order in the tool's output.
